stepsAfterReviewAndAuthorization: Choose the retained review-artifacts/queue.json with Load queue.
Enter your own reviewer ID; compare source evidence and choose Same, Different or Uncertain.
Save checkpoints frequently to a durable folder outside target and keep a backup.
Preserve original downloaded JSON; resume by loading the same queue then saved checkpoint.
checkpointBoundary: 5C external review first. Actual human review and provider work belong to separately authorized 5D. No live calls or final evaluation have run.
uncertainty: Uncertain is not negative. Additional reviews/adjudication will be reported after actual annotations; reserves are not automatically substituted.
